page.layout: One page of text, one column; title block at top centred, then running text below. No margin notes. Digitiser's stamp at bottom right and scan marks at bottom left are not transcribed.

main_text.l: QVÆ vero de nonnullis in ea Articulis controversis,
hac Transactione communi partium placito statuta sunt,
pro perpetua dictæ Pacis declaratione, tam in Iudiciis, quam
alibi observanda habebuntur, donec per Dei gratiam de Reli-
gione ipsa convenerit, non attenta cuiusvis seu Ecclesiastici
seu Politici, intra vel extra Imperium, quocunque tempore
interposita contradictione vel protestatione, quæ omnes inanes
rigorosè prohibeat, ne quisquam publice privatimve concio-
nando, docendo, disputando, scribendo, consulendo, Transa-
ctionem Passaviensem, Pacem Religiosam, vel hanc impri-
mis sive declarationem sive Transactionem uspiam impu-
gnet, dubiam faciat, aut assertiones contrarias inde deducere
conetur. Quicquid etiam contrarii hactenus vel editum, vel

page.notes: Title lines set in capitals and small capitals; the opening words "QVÆ vero" have a large woodcut-style initial Q. The "Iterum" paragraph is italic throughout. Some ink show-through is present in the lower middle of the page and was not transcribed.
